model.rule: solve building and mass together under the same input; never hardcode mass=-building
model.dissipation: damper_force opposes relative velocity; ends constrained to cradle/frame
model.screen_gain: art-directed and marked concept; no meters, seconds-of-real-oscillation, percent reduction

events.event: a few wind streaks arrive at facade from left
small flexural sway develops after forcing; base stays fixed
camera approaches same upper section; city layers leave by parallax
facade aperture opens over existing chamber; beams/cables appear with their attachment
tighten framing to device and retained wall edges
tower frame and mass have evolving relative phase; two projected hydraulic links change length
leave enough time to read connected damping system, not freeze the ball in air
return exterior and recompose matched-scale conceptual pair
same wind and common scale; reference response wider, damped response smaller but nonzero; camera holds

required_before_animation: choose illustrative coupled-model coefficients and validate stability/relative phase
cable lengths, cradle attachment and cylinder stroke checks
